$source: design/styles.css is the shipping stylesheet — these values are its machine-readable mirror plus app-layer values the DevGym screens use. Reference CSS variables in code, never raw hex.

color.textMuted: #605d5d (= neutral.700) — every muted/secondary string. Ink at 55% alpha read 3.65:1 on bg and failed AA (#70); this clears it at 5.83:1 on bg / 5.38:1 on surface. Never mute text with alpha.
color.accent: #ec3013 — a FIELD colour: posters, the passed banner, rules, the 2px focus ring. 3.76:1 on bg / 3.47:1 on surface, so it clears non-text (3:1) but never carries a string (#71).
color.accentText: #ae1800 (= accentRamp.700) — the INK accent: kickers, links, ghost-button labels, outline-tag border + label, and the primary action's field (ground-coloured type on it reads 6.41:1). 6.41:1 on bg / 5.91:1 on surface.
color.accent2: #e15b47 (mono scheme — treat as the same role as accent)

font.heading: Archivo (weight 800)
font.load: Self-hosted: design/fonts/archivo-latin.woff2 (variable, latin) via @font-face in styles.css — covers 400/600/800, no third-party origin

radius.note: Zero everywhere. Never round a corner.

layout.nav: sticky top 0, border-bottom 2px divider, bg ground

semantics.primaryAction: .btn-primary — solid accent-text field (the text-safe step), one per view
semantics.passed: ink + check icon; Exit Gate passed panel = accent field poster (bg-colored type)
semantics.failing: accent-text (accent-700) text + x icon (never a separate green/red pair — red carries attention in this mono scheme)
semantics.locked: row at 0.5 opacity, lock icon, cursor not-allowed
semantics.focus: 2px accent outline, offset 2 — non-text, 3.76:1 on bg (built into styles.css)
